mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with strengthening supply-side activity.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with loosening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% YoY, it signals strong demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY growth > 5% and GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and GDPC1 does not correlate with strong demand and economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement in PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with a tightening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 3% for 3 months does not correlate with restrictive monetary policy.
